qa_pairs.question: What is the maximum tightening torque for an M10 8.8 screw?
What is the difference in torque between M10 10.9 and M10 12.9 specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: The M10 10.9 requires 66 Nm (ft. lbs.) while the M10 12.9 requires 79 Nm (ft. lbs.), a difference of 13 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: How many different M10 thread specifications are shown in the table?
qa_pairs.answer: Three M10 thread specifications are shown: M10 8.8, M10 10.9, and M10 12.9

qa_pairs.question: Which has a higher torque requirement: M10 12.9 or M10x1 10.9?
qa_pairs.answer: M10 12.9 has a higher torque requirement at 79 Nm (ft. lbs.) compared to M10x1 10.9 at 75 Nm (ft. lbs.)

qa_pairs.question: What is the range of torque values for all M10x1 thread specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: The range is from 54 Nm (ft. lbs.) for M10x1 8.8 to 91 Nm (ft. lbs.) for M10x1 12.9
